5.  26-55323  Recommendation to review and if appropriate approve the Mayor’s Fund
  Subcommittee grant application submitted by Urban Social Service and Advocacy
  for funding in the amount of $10,000.

  • The applicant joined the meeting via Teams. The subcommittee asked
  follow-up questions regarding the application and the submitted budget.The
  subcommittee determined that the proposal did not align with the goals and
  priorities of the Mayor’s Fund.
  • The subcommittee expressed concerns that the program does not provide
  funding directly to individuals who are currently unhoused, but instead
  supports individuals who are at risk of becoming unhoused. The
  subcommittee noted that the funding is intended to serve people who are
  already experiencing homelessness.
  • Additional questions were raised regarding the IRS letter that was submitted,
  as it displays a different name than the applicant organization's
  name.Member Wood made a motion to deny the application. The motion
  was seconded by Member Lie.

6.  26-55456  Recommendation to review the proposed $50,000 budget plan for the Mayor's
  Fund Pilot Hygiene Project and discuss submission to the City Manager and City
  Council, with funding provided through the Mayor's Fund.

  • The subcommittee emphasized its preference for the use of existing City-
  owned restroom facilities instead of renting a portable restroom.The
  subcommittee discussed the significance of the pilot program and
  underscored the importance of ensuring that individuals experiencing
  homelessness are treated with dignity and respect.
  • The revised proposal will be sent to staff, the final proposal will be presented
  at the HSAC meeting in August.

  • The subcommittee requested that the final one-page report include more
  detailed financial information. Members would also like to see more
  comprehensive data regarding the number of individuals and families
  assisted. The subcommittee noted that the current reports are too general
  and do not provide sufficient detail to effectively evaluate program outcomes
  and impact.
  • Staff will make revisions to the one-page instruction sheet.

8.  26-55447  Recommendation to review and discuss the current Mayor's Fund application and
  make edits as needed.

  • The subcommittee reviewed the current Mayor’s Fund application and
